name: Phyrexian oil
description: A dark contagion Karn unwittingly introduced, which infects the land and breeds horrors.

timeline.summary: Karn creates Mirrodin, but something goes wrong and he unwittingly introduces Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: He unwittingly introduced a dark contagion: Phyrexian oil.

timeline.summary: Karn brings the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin, which begins transforming the creatures it touches.
timeline.quote: Karn was the bringer of the Phyrexian oil to Mirrodin

pages_say.description: A contagion carried by Phyrexian bodies that first affects the living mind and cannot infect the risen dead; it makes creatures stop caring about self-preservation.
The substance that unites Phyrexians and listens for Norn's orders, now inert.
A Phyrexian substance that Zegana studied and Oba says soaked Ravnica.
A dark contagion Karn unwittingly introduced, which infects the land and breeds horrors.
The substance Karn brought to Mirrodin which slowly transformed the creatures it touched.
